description: This file implements an on-demand page entry handler for Next.js, managing page build states, invalidation, and communication with the client for hot module reloading and page updates.

classes.name: Invalidator
classes.description: Manages webpack compiler invalidation and build process synchronization to prevent multiple concurrent invalidations.

methods.name: disposeInactiveEntries
methods.description: Disposes of inactive page entries based on last active time and maximum inactive age.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the webpack compiler to trigger rebuilds, with handling for webpack version differences.

methods.name: startBuilding
methods.description: Marks the start of a build process.

methods.name: doneBuilding
methods.description: Marks the completion of a build process and triggers a re-invalidation if needed.
